name: Pulse
summary: Nested polygons, one per slice of the spectrum, that swell with their band, jump on the beat and flash on hits.
credit: Example 2 of docs/building-visuals.md. The polygon distance function follows Inigo Quilez's sdRegularPolygon (MIT).
hint: The innermost ring is the bass, the outermost the treble. Each ring swells and brightens with its own band; the beat kicks them all outward and hits flash them.

params.label: Radius
params.help: The outer ring's radius at rest.

params.label: Twist
params.help: Neighbouring rings turn against each other, faster when the music is loud.

params.label: Spectrum
params.help: Each band: every band against its own recent best, so all of them move whatever the mix. In balance: the bands on one scale, so a bass-heavy track looks bass-heavy and quiet bands stay quiet.

params.label: Beat kick
params.help: How far the rings jump outward on each beat.

params.label: Hit flash
params.help: How much every ring brightens on an onset.
